closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 4 of a Form W-2G furnished to the taxpayer (and, on a joint return, the spouse) for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form W-2G box 4 only: it says nothing about box 1 winnings, state or local withholding, or other forms. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form W-2G box 4 statement items, tax year 2025
